mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invocation ( invocation_id, user_id, task_id, trace_id, agent_id, status, created_at, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{invocationId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{traceId}, #{agentId}, #{status}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{startedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{completedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), task_id = VALUES(task_id), trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), status = VALUES(status), created_at = VALUES(created_at), started_at = VALUES(started_at), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at)
